image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a small snake on a rough, grey gravel or asphalt surface. The snake has a slender, cylindrical body with smooth, glossy scales that exhibit iridescent blue/purple sheen under the light. The dorsal coloration is dark brown to blackish, while the ventral side (belly) and lower flanks are a distinct reddish-pink or coral color. The head is small, rounded, and barely distinct from the neck, with a blunt snout. The eye is small and dark. The tail tapers slightly but remains relatively short and blunt within the frame.
